sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case involves the seizure of private property by the government. the side that brought the case argues this action requires a hearing. The government relies on the initial probable cause finding.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: the side that brought the case wants a hearing before the government seizes their property.
The government wants to seize property based only on probable cause.

paragraphs: This case defines the balance between government power and private property rights. It determines when citizens can challenge the seizure of their assets. The outcome shapes the scope of due process protections for property owners.
